module_summary: Four-channel UART aggregator: per-channel sync FIFOs feed a round-robin arbiter whose grant muxes the winning FIFO byte into a UART transmitter, popping the FIFO on handshake.

anchors.name: ch_valid
anchors.why: Per-channel write valids into the four input FIFOs

anchors.name: ch_data
anchors.why: Per-channel byte payloads written into the input FIFOs

anchors.name: uart_tx
anchors.why: Serial UART output line driven by the transmitter child

anchors.name: n4_e46
anchors.why: One-hot arbiter grant selecting FIFO byte and gating FIFO pops

anchors.name: ch_ready
anchors.why: Per-channel FIFO not-full ready back to the sources

anchors.name: uart_busy
anchors.why: Transmitter busy indication from UART child

anchors.name: n2_84a
anchors.why: FIFO non-empty out_valids forming arbiter request vector

anchors.name: n3_bb8
anchors.why: Grant-selected FIFO byte driven into the UART tx_data

anchors.name: n5_b37
anchors.why: Grant-valid driving UART tx_valid and arbiter accept

anchors.name: n1_c30
anchors.why: UART tx_ready; with grant-valid accepts byte, pops FIFO and rotates arbiter

anchors.name: n7_759
anchors.why: Per-FIFO pop (out_ready): grant masked by UART transfer handshake

anchors.name: n6_935
anchors.why: Array of FIFO head bytes feeding the grant mux

groups.name: channel FIFOs
groups.description: Four sync FIFOs buffering per-channel bytes with valid/ready

groups.name: round-robin arbiter
groups.description: Selects one non-empty FIFO, grant held until UART accepts

groups.name: grant mux
groups.description: One-hot mux routing granted FIFO byte to transmitter

groups.name: UART transmitter
groups.description: Serializes the selected byte onto uart_tx with busy status
